block.comment: Normal follow fallback: F=10 holds; left/right proportional steering. Lap finish, wide marker, short gap and sharp-turn states have priority. The preserved legacy F=0 loop counter is bypassed by the gap/turn states.
Original 115200-baud raw ADC/F telemetry; no new capture protocol.
Position weights: A4=-1, A3=0, A2=+1. Curve base150, gain150; minimum inner8. Straight command230 is separate.
Exclude A1 and A5 from decisions; control uses A4/A3/A2 only.
Read all five ADCs; preserve original raw telemetry.

Start on the narrow line LEFT of the large finish patch, facing away from finish. Three-center-sensor control, sharp corners and short gaps. After departure/minimum run, sustained wide line latches finish stop. This is not measured lap localization. Button waits at boot only.

Bounded sharp-corner pivot. Outer forward150, inner reverse143. After minimum30ms, F4/F6/F12 starts forward differential capture. Three consecutive captures finish at curve base150, not straight230. Timeout latches stop; no measured angle or automatic restart.

Short gap PWM70 with fixed250ms deadline. On side-line return, forward differential capture starts immediately (25/70 or45/70 mirrored). No reverse in gap state. Three narrow samples finish; wide line returns to marker handling.

Lift: first confirmed wide marker after narrow-line departure, based on user route assumption. Stop without alignment drive; user-requested wait23350ms from stop command, not measured settled feedback. This is below the published27s +/-5% timing. Auto exit PWM45 with1500ms limit. Consume marker once. PWM zero is not active braking. Disable LIFT_ENABLED for the earlier practice mat without a lift.
